text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Ben Ali receives president of Union Tunisienne de l'Agriculture et de la Peche, Abdelbaki Bacha, who briefs him on results of committee brainstorming session on modernising agricultural sector.
- Eighth conference of directors of Arab Chambers of Commerce, Industry and Agriculture to be held in Tunis April 28-30.
- Tunisian, French chambers of commerce hold cooperation talks in Tunis.
- Experts from Mediterranean countries start meeting on cooperation in red meat sector.
- New taxation system for real estate.
- Tunisia to review shipping legislation next June.
